name: meld
invariant: Meld is structural composition (the free monoidal tensor) of two independently-generated histories -- concatenation of event logs -- and is distinct from Bind-based concurrency, which couples elements within a single shared history instead of combining two separate ones.
explanation: Meld operates directly on two History values before either is under a single Arbiter's option-space accounting, so it does not fit the single-Arbiter event-stream schema the other fixtures use here. This fixture is intentionally marked 'manual': the automated runners parse and structurally validate it but do not yet execute it end-to-end. `spherepop-kernel::History::meld` and its unit tests (see spherepop-kernel/src/history.rs) are the current executable evidence for this operation; wiring Meld into the flat-fixture schema is tracked as follow-up work.
